summary: Clough Global Dividend & Income Fund filed an 8-K announcing the Board's renewal of its open-market share repurchase program. The program permits the Fund to buy back up to 5% of its outstanding common shares through June 30, 2027. Repurchases are at the discretion of the adviser, subject to market conditions, and are designed to enhance shareholder value when shares trade at a discount to net asset value. The renewal follows an original June 2023 launch. There is no fixed price, premium, or tender offer mechanics. Watch for periodic disclosure of buyback volumes in shareholder reports and potential NAV discount narrowing.
